name: Loop
summary: Waveform rings born at the centre and pushed outward, each lagging the last; quiet slices leave dark rings.
credit: After the Loop in Felix Turner's Uberviz (https://uberviz.io). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Each ring is one slice of the waveform, born at the centre and pushed outward by the next, so a sound ripples out ring by ring; quiet slices leave dark rings. Twist turns each ring against the last for a spiral.

params.label: Rate
params.help: New rings per second; lower is a longer lag between rings.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.

params.label: Bar sway
params.help: How far the rings turn to and fro once a bar, as much as the beat is sure.
